text:
Ava (CS): pinging the team — KelpStream is asking for a short-lived APAC migration window + proxy egress allowlist. They want a temporary rate bump during their cutover. Can we do 2x QPS for 48h and add their SG peering CIDR?
Maria (KelpStream Ops): thanks Ava. cutover window is Thu 03:00-07:00 UTC. traffic will move to ap-southeast-1 (Singapore). we'll validate traffic from 35.196.128.0/18 and 34.88.0.0/15 — need those added.
Rajat (SE): noted. are they hitting any token/latency issues today that we should watch during the bump?
Maria (KelpStream Ops): baseline latency ~120ms. we saw spikes to ~400ms on ~6k-token requests yesterday, but overall success rate fine. renewal next month — performance matters a lot.
Ava (CS): putting renewal context on this — they're high ARR, evaluating Dedicated in Q2 if cutover goes well. want to avoid flakey rollout.
Nate (NetOps): I can add a temporary egress rule for those CIDRs to the APAC proxy pool. prefer to set auto-revoke at 72h. confirmation on ports and protocol?
Maria (KelpStream Ops): only outbound HTTPS (443). no other ports.
Yang (Platform): for the rate bump: do we want to use a transient rate-policy or adjust their customer rate-limit? I recommend a per-customer "temp_burst" route that doubles token QPS and has an expiry.
Rajat (SE): agree on temp_burst. please also enable prefix KV caching for their chat routes to mitigate long prompt costs — will reduce tail latency.
Ava (CS): plan: (1) Nate adds CIDR allowlist to apac-proxy (auto-revoke 72h), (2) Platform toggles temp_burst for KelpStream for Thu 03–07 UTC + fallback to normal after window, (3) SE enables prefix caching and we instrument evals during the window.
Nate (NetOps): queued. I'll create the rule and post the config snippet once applied. ETA 30m.
config-bot: egress-rule created: id=egress-ks-175888, cidrs=[35.196.128.0/18,34.88.0.0/15], ports=[443], region=ap-southeast-1, auto_revoke=259200s.
Rajat (SE): thanks. Yang — can you author the rollout and add a canary (10%) for first 15m then 100%? want to watch latency & 5xx.
Yang (Platform): yes. creating rollout policy now: name=ks-temp-burst-175888, phases=[canary:10%:15m,full:100%:rest], rate_multiplier=2.0, expires=2025-06-12T07:00:00Z. applying in 10m.
Ava (CS): capturing customer feedback request: ask KelpStream to run these two synthetic prompts during the window: (1) 512-token eval (generation), (2) 6k-token long-form summarization. we need latency, error, and cost delta.
Maria (KelpStream Ops): will run tests and share logs to the onboarding drive link: https://redwooddrive.company/koplevels/ks-cutover.
Rajat (SE): small config snippet for Platform to enable prefix caching and kv settings:
```
route: /chat
features:
  prefix_kv_cache: true
  kv_ttl: 3600
  max_cached_prefix_tokens: 2048
```
Yang (Platform): got it. I'll push those flags for their tenant only.
Nate (NetOps): egress changes applied and validated from our side. test curl from one of their IPs shows 200 from apac proxy. snippet:
```
curl -H "Host: api.redwood.company" --resolve api.redwood.company:443:35.196.200.10 https://api.redwood.company/health
```
config-bot: rollout ks-temp-burst-175888 created, state=scheduled, starts=2025-06-12T03:00:00Z.
Ava (CS): tagging renewal ops — since renewal is next month, can we schedule a post-cutover health check and exec summary to present to customer? prefer 2 business-day SLA on the summary.
Rajat (SE): I'll draft the exec summary template (latency, p95/p99, error-rate, cost delta, recommendations).
Maria (KelpStream Ops): appreciate that. one more ask — can we extend the trial cache size if we see missed KV hits? it may help with their long-form queries.
Yang (Platform): we can bump tenant cache to 3GB for the window if needed. will monitor memory pressure.
Ava (CS): follow-ups: - Nate to post the egress rule id (done) - Yang to confirm rollout applied and to share dashboards - Rajat to prepare exec summary template - Maria to run synthetics and upload results - Ava to coordinate renewal outreach after health check.
Maria (KelpStream Ops): all set from customer side. will be on call Thu 02:30 UTC and we'll ping if anything smells wrong. :thumbsup:
Rajat (SE): adding a quick checklist item to track feedback: noted their comment about tokenizer spikes — will collect tokenization logs and file under the ticket.
Yang (Platform): rollout started (canary) — 10% traffic passing to ap-southeast-1, no errors so far. p95 latency steady ~130ms.
config-bot: notification: ks-temp-burst-175888 phase=canary success.
Ava (CS): great. leaving this thread open for post-window findings. pls drop the post-cutover summary here and I'll attach to the renewal playbook.
Maria (KelpStream Ops): test results uploaded. short summary: 512-token: p95 140ms, 6k-token: p95 410ms -> slight improvement vs yesterday. no 5xx. full logs in drive. thanks team. :heart:
Rajat (SE): drafting exec summary now, will post by EOD Fri.
Yang (Platform): auto-revoke triggered; egress rule egress-ks-175888 revoked after 72h per policy.
Nate (NetOps): confirming cleanup done.
Ava (CS): closing loop — customer is happy with cutover quality. capturing this as a positive renewal signal. thanks everyone! :tada:
